content:
ela: Follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A re: credits/quota/usage policy. A couple of nuanced asks from Sales & Ops: promo credit behavior, per-route dev vs prod quotas, emergency top-ups, and a small set of throttling reason codes. Can we capture clear lines here so Demo decks don't contradict legal?
omar: Short canonical: credits = prepaid buckets applied to Hosted usage; quotas = enforced windows (requests/min, tokens/day) applied at org/route/pool; Dedicated = reserved throughput commitments with configurable burst windows and isolation.
sales-lead: Sales asked specifically: 1) Are promo credits eligible for bursting? 2) Can customers buy emergency top-ups during a live incident? 3) Should we show different remaining-quota UI for dev vs prod keys?
omar: Quick answers: 1) Promo credit buckets are often excluded from auto-burst eligibility by default (we can opt-in per campaign). 2) Emergency top-ups are possible via Customer Success / Finance UI (instant purchase applied as a new prepaid bucket). 3) We recommend surfacing per-key or per-route quotas separately in UIs (dev keys usually have lower rate ceilings); public usage API will return per-key counters.
ops-bot: infra-note: monitoring will add per-key burn-rate projections for 24h and alert at 60/90% by default; enterprise can customize.
legal-bot: Legal note: standard self-serve credits (trial, promo, prepaid) are non-refundable and expire per TTL. Any rollover/refund must be in contract language and signed by Finance. Also recommend we add a short line in the playbook clarifying promo buckets may be excluded from burst.
sales-lead: Important for demos: can we display a human-friendly reason when a request is throttled? e.g., "Throttled: monthly quota reached" vs error 429.
omar: Yes, API will include a throttling_reason code and human_summary: codes = ["RATE_LIMIT","POOL_EXHAUSTION","PROMO_EXCLUDED","FALLBACK_MODEL"]. Human summary string will be short and localized later.
docs-bot: I'll add those codes to the FAQ draft. Also need a concrete set of example numbers for the cheat-sheet. Sales prefers numbers different from last quarter.
ela: Let's pick fresh illustrative numbers (label clearly): Trial: 90k tokens/day; dev key rate: 40 reqs/min; burst cap 12k tokens/30s. Startup: 700k tokens/day; burst cap 150k tokens/90s. Enterprise: negotiated. Callout: promo buckets excluded from bursting unless explicitly enabled.
omar: Additional operational guarantee: we do not preempt in-flight requests due to quota checks. We finish current responses then apply backpressure on subsequent requests (throttle, fallback, or queue).
ops-bot: infra-note: new endpoint will be GET /v1/orgs/{org_id}/usage returning credit_buckets (list), remaining_balance, per_key_counters, token_windows, active_rate_limits, and a short human_summary. SDK helper planned: usage.summary(org_id).
legal-bot: Also capture that emergency top-ups create a new prepaid bucket and billing will reflect the purchase immediately; refunds still per contract.
docs-bot: I'll draft a one-page cheat-sheet: canonical blurb, example numbers, burst semantics, throttling codes + example GET response + UI snippet for "remaining credits". Will post PR and tag Legal & Ops for sign-off.
sales-lead: Great, please ping when PR is up so we can update decks and playbook. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
